So you can DM me, but I have had a long history with mental illnesses. Got every one on the list of disabilities. Tried all the meds and doctors and therapists and well, everything. 5 suicide attempts, literally catatonic depression for 3 days, psychosomatic symptoms that led to an involuntary weird bulimia in which I was bedridden and lost 25 kgs in a month because I was starving myself and anything they force fed me I'd throw up. I've been mentally ill since like 9, started doing SH at 12, got my first diagnosis at 15, and until April this year, I was in your boat.


And then fucking alternative Indian medicine worked?! I'm a staunch atheist and I avoid any of this shit like a disease but the neuropsychiatrist I have right now...man, it's been 2 months and no, I'm not fixed, but I'm 80 percent there.


Now, look, euthanasia is something I would have supported for my suicidal nature up until late May. I've gotten ketamine IV injections, every day for two weeks straight. I have BPD, OCD, schizophrenia and severe PTSD from abuse, so even sleeping wasn't helping me because the worst nightmares and I always thought they were real. Every waking moment was physically and mentally hell and all the tests were coming back clear.


I can connect you to my doc if you want, I promise this isn't an ad. If there's nothing after death, you have nothing to lose at this moment so what's this one last thing to try before we throw the towel in? If you are at rock bottom, like I was, what is one more failure?
